    // The faces carried from a component's own pool into the set's shared one.
    ShiftedFaces(faces: Array<TriangleFace>, offset: Integer): Array<TriangleFace>
        => faces.Map(f => TriangleFace(
            VertexIndex(f.A.Value + offset),
            VertexIndex(f.B.Value + offset),
            VertexIndex(f.C.Value + offset)));
